scope: Read-only local source review interpreting root-recorded production UI observations. No live calls, browser inspection, tests, source refresh, financial calculation, or release-state mutation by this reviewer.

observation_provenance.ui: Observed by root on the production financial-position summary page; not independently observed in a browser by this reviewer.
observation_provenance.page_export: Root reported a private current-page XLSX capture. This reviewer verified the page-only export implementation but did not inspect the workbook bytes.

source_findings.finding: The initial summary excludes live open-cost projection and is marked forecast_pending. The summary UI automatically requests forecast using the summary revision and period binding.

The UI accepts a forecast replacement only when its contract is valid, its view is forecast, forecast_pending is false, and its session scope, revision, as_of and started_at exactly match the summary. Displaying the forecast table in this UI supports acceptance of that bound result; the raw binding values were not captured by this reviewer.

A displayed forecast table alone does not rule out a source-reader failure. Recognized source errors can be returned as a bounded incomplete forecast with empty currencies and groups, diagnostic issues and forecast_pending false.

A nonzero known subtotal for unreceived products derives from open-cost exposure groups. The empty cost-exposure fallback used for recognized read failures cannot generate that nonzero subtotal. This supports a populated cost preview or a valid same-snapshot cached preview rather than the empty failure fallback.

The displayed product-cost timeout sentence is produced by the saved period-bound profit snapshot, through quality.source_errors for products or context. Profit rows are built from project_profit(state, currency), independently of the newly requested open-cost exposure. It is not direct evidence that the new forecast request timed out.

The current-page XLSX action builds and downloads a workbook from the already loaded report without requesting financial data again. The all-sections export is different and issues another financial read.

The page workbook contains formatted report dates, human-readable completeness, message text and displayed rows. It does not preserve raw revision, session scope, ISO binding dates, source collection, raw diagnostic codes or the raw forecast_pending value. readableMessages retains message text only.

limitations: The UI and exported-file existence are root-recorded observations, not independent browser observations by this reviewer.
The open-cost reader has a short same-snapshot cache. A displayed populated preview does not prove that this particular request performed a cold database read.
No raw summary or forecast response, exact snapshot binding values, complete diagnostic array, database query plan, or isolated timing was inspected here.
Financial actual, forecast and profit completeness remain distinct from transport success and release verification.
The saved-profit error requires its own source diagnosis and a separately authorized recalculation to establish a new result; opening or exporting this page does not perform that recalculation.
No monetary amount, owner identifier, session scope value, customer detail or private financial row is retained in this review.
